title: Conformalized Physics-Informed Weak Regression for Parameter Estimation in Epidemic Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19058v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compartment models of infectious diseases are often linear in coefficients that are physical parameters or products or ratios of them. We exploit this with closed-form least squares and equip the estimates with distribution-free uncertainty. Physics-informed regression (PIR) fits the parameters to finite-difference derivatives of the data; we introduce physics-informed weak regression (PIWR), which integrates the model in time instead, needs no derivatives of the data, estimates the initial state jointly and is high-order accurate. To quantify uncertainty we wrap both estimators in split conformal prediction, with a calibration population generated by the physics-based model itself, giving simultaneous intervals for all parameters with a finite-sample coverage guarantee. A residual-adaptive factor, computed without ground truth, scales the intervals to each data set (PIWR-RACC). On the eleven benchmark models of disease-informed neural

translated_title: 传染病模型参数估计的保形化物理信息弱回归
translated_abstract: 传染病的房室模型在系数上通常是线性的，这些系数是物理参数或它们的乘积或比率。我们利用这一特性，采用闭式最小二乘法进行估计，并为估计结果提供无分布假设的不确定性量化。物理信息回归（PIR）通过将参数拟合到数据的有限差分导数上来实现；我们提出了物理信息弱回归（PIWR），它改为在时间上对模型进行积分，无需对数据求导，可联合估计初始状态，并具有高阶精度。为了量化不确定性，我们将这两种估计器都纳入分割保形预测框架中，其校准群体由基于物理的模型自身生成，从而为所有参数提供具有有限样本覆盖率保证的同步置信区间。一个残差自适应因子（无需真实值即可计算）可将区间缩放至各个数据集（PIWR-RACC）。在十一个疾病信息神经……的基准模型上（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出物理信息弱回归（PIWR）方法，通过在时间上积分模型而非对数据求导来估计传染病模型参数，并结合由物理模型自身生成校准集的分割保形预测，为所有参数提供具有有限样本覆盖率保证的无分布同步置信区间。
